description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between perplexity and the parameter M for three different models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—across M values ranging from 3 to 7. The x-axis, labeled “M,” is linearly scaled with integer tick marks at 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity,” is also linearly scaled, ranging from approximately 15 to 45, with major tick marks at 20, 30, and 40. The LLaMA1-7B model (green line with circle markers) starts at a perplexity of ~28 at M=3, dips slightly to ~25 at M=5, then rises to ~36 at M=7. The LLaMA1-13B model (orange line with star markers) begins at ~20 at M=3, declines to ~17 at M=5, remains flat through M=6 and M=7, then rises slightly to ~20 at M=7. The Vicuna-7B model (blue line with triangle markers) starts at ~41 at M=3, decreases to ~35 at M=5, remains stable through M=6 and M=7, then rises back to ~40 at M=7. All lines are solid, and the legend in the upper right corner identifies each model by color and marker shape.
